messages:
alex.m: Quick heads-up — external assessor onboarding next Tue. Scope: staging, log-aggregation bucket (read-only), and a small set of prod metadata endpoints. We need: RBAC snapshot + ephemeral assessor roles, KMS key access pattern for evidence upload, and an audit-log integrity plan. Can we sync Wed 10am?

maria_s: +1 for Wed 10. Who owns the ephemeral role creation and presigned upload flow? Also need retention/TTL for evidence objects called out in SOW.

samir: I can own the ephemeral role. Plan: create an assessor-temp role with AssumeRole for the vendor principal, set max session duration 1h, and a timebound policy. We'll use an S3 bucket limited to uploads under evidence/{assessment-id}/. After upload, a lambda will move objects to a sealed prefix and apply KMS-Encrypt with our evidence key. Example IAM snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/evidence/*"]}]
}
```

jess: For audit logs — we must enable CloudTrail multi-region, send to dedicated logs bucket, and enable log-file validation. Also enable object lock / legal hold for the evidence bucket retention window. Can we require vendor uploads be server-side encrypted with our KMS key (alias/assess-evidence)? That way we have key wrapping logs.

samir: yes — we'll require sse-kms with kms:EncryptionContext that includes assessment-id so it's searchable in KMS CloudTrail. Will also add kms:ViaService restriction to avoid cross-service weirdness.

ops-oncall: FYI — if lambda moves objects and re-encrypts, watch for eventual consistency; we should keep an audit trail entry in our telemetry for each move (request id, checksum). Also set a lifecycle rule to transition to cold storage after 30 days.

alex.m: Good. Two questions: 1) Who will sign off on RBAC changes? 2) What's the retest window process — do we create a follow-up ephemeral role or reuse same? Need to record in remediation tracker.

maria_s: I can sign off on RBAC for assessor roles once samir posts the exact policies. For retest, vendor wants a 2-week window and a short re-ingest slot. Best practice is new ephemeral credentials per retest (safer).

samir: Agreed. We'll create a templated CloudFormation stack: assessor-temp-{vendor}-{ts} that provisions role + bucket prefix policy + KMS key access entry in key policy (explicit grant). Then we can tear down after evidence ingestion. Small CFN snippet I'll post in the planning doc.

jess: On the KMS side, security asks for an HSM-backed CMK and an audit entry in our KMS logs that includes the grant ID. ops-oncall — can you confirm we can create a temporary grant for the assessor principal and revoke it after the window?

ops-oncall: Yes, temporary grant is possible. We'll orchestrate grant creation via a runbook so revocation is automatic after the window. I'll add a step to record the grant ARN into the remediation tracker.

deploy-bot: Reminder: there's a scheduled config deploy for staging at Wed 09:30 (will not affect buckets, but role CFN changes should be queued after that).

alex.m: Great. Action items: 
- samir: draft CFN + IAM policy + KMS grant flow (owner)
- jess: confirm CloudTrail validation & object-lock retention steps (owner)
- ops-oncall: runbook for grant lifecycle and evidence-moving lambda monitoring (owner)
- maria_s: sign-off once policies posted; coordinate vendor scheduling for retest window (owner)
- alex.m: create remediation tracker entry and invite vendor to planning call

maria_s: I'll coordinate vendor availability after Wed sync and add the retest cadence to the tracker. Vendor asked if they can stream logs via our secure upload API instead of S3 presigned — is that supported?

samir: We have an upload endpoint but for forensics we prefer immutable object storage (S3 + object-lock) — streaming API is okay for live telemetry, but final artifacts should be S3 to preserve checksums. We'll accept both but will require final canonical evidence dump in S3.

jess: Also note: add monitoring alert for any attempts to use older grants/roles (unauthorized assume attempts). That helps triage suspicious activity during the assessment.

ops-oncall: I'll add CloudWatch metric filter + PagerDuty rule for AssumeRole failures on assessor roles.

alex.m: Thanks — if no objections I'll post this plan to the intake ticket and tag everyone. Wed 10am calendar invite incoming. :thumbsup:

maria_s: LGTM.

samir: SGTM.

jess: fine by me.

(End of thread)
